pages.title: Cedar Labs - fictional company overview
pages.text: Cedar Labs is a fictional company created for RAG learning exercises. Its headquarters is in Pune. The company was founded in 2022. This handbook contains invented facts and is not real company policy.

pages.title: Learning and workplace policy
pages.text: Each Cedar Labs employee has an annual learning budget of INR 24,000. Employees may work remotely up to three days per week. Learning purchases require approval from the employee's manager.

pages.title: Product strategy and support
pages.text: Cedar Labs plans to grow by serving university research teams and improving customer retention. Its fictional product is called Atlas Notes. Customer support is available Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 17:00 India Standard Time.
